method: Normal approximation, equal independent groups, standardized variance assumed 1
limitations: Provisional assumptions, not an exact power calculation or an empirically estimated effect; two endpoints each targeted at .90 power gives at least .80 probability of both succeeding by the union bound under their stated alternatives. No participants recruited.
interest_support_condition: Lower one-sided 97.5% confidence bound above zero; this stronger positive-interest result would support the no-reduction conjunction. A nonsignificant difference would remain unresolved.
